arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
temp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/leads-bootstrap-memory-test.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT
git -c credential.helper= clone -q --depth 1 --branch docs/bootstrap-historical-engine-recovery-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/telegram-robot-leads.git "$temp/repo"
cd "$temp/repo"
echo CHECKED_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)
echo CHECKED_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
git -c credential.helper= fetch -q --depth 12 origin main:refs/remotes/origin/main
git diff --check origin/main HEAD
echo CHANGED_FILES
git diff --name-only origin/main HEAD
python3 -B - <<'PY'

boot=Path('docs/BOOTSTRAP.md').read_text()

  'legacy source':'1862998844782764d263ee8e49a1476a7f86beac',
  'shared history':'histórico global durável',
  'account 1 region':'PT_ES',
  'account 2 region':'EU_OTHER',
  'group joined':'1 adesão a grupo',
  'installed SHA':'8298503f7b21466ebf14b9f164f9e103c9c781e7',
  'recent audit':'41250971838',
  'no historic proof':'não é possível',
  'consent distinction':'Não reativar recolha indiscriminada',
}
for k,v in mandatory.items():
 assert v in (boot+state),k
 print('DOC_CONTRACT_PASS',k)
assert '## Motor antigo: recuperação do conhecimento' in boot
assert 'próximo passo' in boot.lower()
assert '## Situação verificada e prioridade seguinte' in state
print('DOCUMENTS_CONSISTENT_PASS')

sudo -n /opt/telegram-robot-leads/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -q
echo BOOTSTRAP_MEMORY_TESTS_PASS
